comment: DISSOLVED SUBSTANCES (src/sim/solutes.h, docs/PLAN_solutes.md, docs/PLAN_alchemy_chemistry.md). A powder named in `from` dissolves into any liquid in `solvents` at `dissolveChance` per-mille per tick per contact, becoming MASS in that liquid (`yieldPerVoxel` units per voxel; a full cell holds 0..255 units = its concentration). Up to `saturation` concentration; past it the powder stays powder. Mass spreads through the liquid by pair exchange at `diffusivity`/256 and is DISCARDED below `floor` (the dilution floor -- a pinch in a lake disperses and is gone). `densityPerUnit` makes the liquid heavier with concentration (brine sinks under fresh water). `tint`/`tintStrength`/`glow` shift how the liquid looks at saturation. `precipitatesTo` is what a solvent leaves when it evaporates or boils off. `converts`: once a solvent cell reaches `cMin`, it BECOMES `into` and its solute mass is spent in it (fairy dust concentrated in water is enchanted water). The world's solute layer and the alchemy bench (and a vessel's dissolved portions) read this same table; one eighth of a dissolved portion = yieldPerVoxel/8 units of world mass.

species.name: salt
species.//converts: PACKAGE E: salt concentrated in ENCHANTED water makes holy water (blessed water with salt in it). reactions.json has the same as a salt + enchanted_water pair rule for the world until the solute layer carries it.

species.//: PACKAGE E. REAL. Sugar dissolves readily and a lot of it (saturation 255); concentrated past 160 a water cell BECOMES syrup. Sweet water is a little heavier. Evaporated, it leaves sugar.
species.name: sugar

species.//: PACKAGE E. REAL-ish. Ink: charcoal ground fine hangs in water (and in spirits) as a black suspension -- lampblack ink, the oldest there is. It barely goes in (10 per-mille, saturation 80: most of a charcoal pile stays charcoal), but a little blackens a lot (tintStrength 220). No convert: ink is a tint.
species.name: ink

species.//: PACKAGE E. REAL. Copper sulfate: blue vitriol dissolves into water and turns it the blue every chemistry set knows (tint strength 200). A saturated solution is denser than water. Evaporated, it leaves the crystals.
species.name: vitriol

species.//: PACKAGE E. Foxfire in water: luminous spores dissolved make the water GLOW (glow 160 at saturation), and past 96 a cell becomes a potion of light (glow_potion). Evaporated, the spores come back.
species.name: lumen

species.//: PACKAGE E. REAL. Gold in aqua regia (chloroauric acid): the only solvent gold has. The acid turns gold-orange and faintly bright with it. Evaporated, the gold is left behind as dust -- how gold is refined.
species.name: aurum
